name.description: Workout name shown in the Wahoo app and on the ELEMNT

starts.description: Start time in ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-18T18:00:00+02:00. Without an offset it is read in WAHOO_TIMEZONE (default Europe/Berlin)

plan_id.description: ID of a plan (from create_plan or list_plans) to attach

route_id.description: ID of a route to attach

workout_type_id.description: Wahoo workout type ID: 12 = indoor biking (default), 0 = outdoor biking, 61 = indoor trainer, 1 = running, 5 = treadmill

allow_outside_window.description: Schedule even if the start is outside today .. today + 6 days. Wahoo accepts it, but the devices will not receive it
